user.title: Water heater switch
user.description: Pick the switch or smart plug that powers a storage water heater and reports its power.

data_description.switch_entity: The on/off switch that powers the heater. It will be controlled through the new water heater entity.
data_description.power_entity: The power reading in W of that switch. This is the model's main input.
data_description.tank_volume: From the heater's label, e.g. 35 L for a Joven JSH35.

settings.title: Starting settings for {device}
settings.description: You can change these later on the device page.

data_description.thermostat: Water temperature when the tank is full. If unknown, measure the hot tap right after a reheat finishes.
data_description.shower_flow: Litres per minute at the shower head. If you have two heads, use their average.
data_description.shower_temperature: Temperature of the mixed water you shower with.
data_description.cold_water_temperature: Temperature of the cold mains water.
data_description.learn_from_history: Replay the recorder's history of the switch to learn the heater and start with the current tank state.
data_description.import_statistics: Write hourly statistics for the replayed period, so water and energy charts start before today.

abort.already_configured: This switch is already set up.

data_description.shower_threshold: A reheat that used more water heat than this counts as a shower.
data_description.room_temperature: Used for the heat loss model. Heat loss itself is learned.
